_comment: F3 self-refresh: the loader atomically replaces this WHOLE file with the own-repo copy when that copy's last_verified is strictly newer (bounded to today+1d). Manual local edits MUST bump last_verified — a newer repo copy overwrites uncommitted local edits by design. A SoT row wins over the litellm overlay permanently, so the three rows that deliberately break their family prefix are pinned here and only an operator edit can move them: claude-fable-5-2 and claude-opus-5-5, each priced on every field below the row a missing own row falls back to (the client's longest family prefix; on the server the family's highest-version row), and claude-fable-5-1 at cache_read 0.25 against the claude-fable-5 family 1.0. claude-sonnet-5-5 equals its claude-sonnet-5 prefix on every field and keeps an own row for its known-model status. A row also flips its id unknown->is_known, so backfill-cost-events.py --reprice rewrites stored core.cost_events rows for it at this rate retroactively (calc_cost keys on each row's event_date and none of these rows declares tiers); the last_verified bump re-stamps the WHOLE file, suppressing cost-tracker.sh's stale advisory for every row for stale_after_days after last_verified.
